item.description:
MetalFlight 0.1.9 Beta 7 adds an experimental **D3DMetal** renderer under **Settings → Renderer**. Mullion stays the default.
MetalFlight ships none of Apple's files. To enable D3DMetal, install the new runtime `2026.11.12-dev12-preview2-d3dmetal1` (**Settings → Updates → Preview**, then **Update**), open your own **Game Porting Toolkit 4.0 beta 3** disk image and import it again. Only that exact toolkit build is accepted; file hashes and Apple's signatures are checked at import and before each launch.
On the maintainer's M1 Pro, the 4K menu video plays at normal speed and a flight works; at one spot D3DMetal reached at most 44 FPS against Mullion's 32 with the same settings. Long flights, repeated launches and other Macs are untested, and D3DMetal has known limits (see the release notes). App and runtime updates are separate. The macOS app is ad-hoc signed and has no Apple notarization. For a manual install, extract the ZIP and move MetalFlight to Applications.
